Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE production-concept sprite for a strict directly overhead 2D horror game. Create a new mutated SCORPION belonging to the SAME visual species family as reference 2, the existing Stalker. Reference 1 is the independent skeletal template: follow its top-view positions, front UP, exact 8 separate walking legs (four per side), TWO separate long front pedipalp arms each ending in a single TWO-finger pincer, ONE compact six-link curved tail behind the abdomen toward screen-right. Skeletal lines are guide ONLY and must not appear in finished artwork. Match the framing/centres of the skeleton canvas 1024 square: body axis x=512 from y=391 to705; eye at (512,480); walking knees left approx (349,388),(315,473),(318,609),(356,704), right mirrored; feet (277,307),(240,466),(247,667),(298,789), right mirrored. Pincer arm joints left (468,426),(393,310),(325,232),(318,194), terminal two tapered fingers to (342,116) and (267,130); right mirrored. Tail root(512,704) then (512,772),(529,834),(580,885),(641,874),(672,820),stingtip(645,776). Keep all parts and gaps legible.
Style reference 2: fleshy pale desaturated grey-pink / muted rose, a compact rounded triangular forebody with ONE readable pale iris and dark pupil on the dorsal surface, slender articulated legs with simple rounded joints and ivory bone-like sharp ends. Compact segmented abdomen; short clear tail with a bone stinger. It is a fast low-scuttling predator with eight weight-bearing legs, no human shoulders, arms, hands or toes. Front pincers are separate weapons, not walking limbs. Skin has broad simple painted soft volumes like Stalker, dark restrained contour, very sparse folds at actual joints, a few small irregular blood smears near tips only; reduce microtexture substantially. Avoid insect brown/gold armour, glossy photoreal 3D render, heavy veins, tiny spikes everywhere or repeated red seams. Preserve neutral skeleton proportions, especially torso size and actual leg hinge locations. Give each pincer one fixed and one hinged curved pointed jaw, no extra fingers. Strict orthographic dorsal, see only top surfaces, no visible frontal face, no isometric view. Very mild nondirectional shading within the body, no cast ground shadow, no lighting glow. Entire creature with 70 px clear outer margins, genuine transparent background, no floor, no labels, no grid, no diagram elements, no border. Single clean sprite only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the scorpion artwork to correct. Image 2 is the mandatory INDEPENDENT SKELETON GUIDE (1024-square; scale guide uniformly to artwork canvas). Image 3 is its failed bone-overlay diagnostic, showing where the artwork missed the intended skeleton. Correct ANATOMY, keeping the pale rose fleshy Stalker-family style, single central eye, body shape and clear top-down transparent sprite. Do not paint any lines, points, captions or labels. Exact requirement: each of the EIGHT WALKING LEGS has only TWO principal segments with ONE exposed circular knee: root -> knee -> pointed distal leg. The FIRST/upper pair wrongly has TWO separate circular joints along each leg; remove the extra joint and make a single straight proximal link root to the CYAN knee position in image2, then a straight tapering distal link from knee to the cyan toe point. All eight knees AND bone tip positions must follow image2, not the previous rendered legs. Do not keep the previous wrong knee positions. Keep all leg gaps clear. The sharp ivory material may curve mildly after the bony endpoint; do not invent extra hinges. Move middle upper walking-leg knees to the cyan point and redirect the pointed tibia to the toe shown, instead of bending it backward. Two front pincer arms stay a distinct pair: roots, elbows, wrists, hinge and TWO pincers follow the PURPLE guide chain. Shorten oversized pincer fingers so BOTH tips remain near the purple guide endpoints, roughly y=140..160 on the 1254 canvas, never y=50. One fixed finger and one moving finger only, no hand. Rear tail must follow GOLD chain from abdomen straight briefly downward then curl to the right, segment centres at the gold joints, and terminate at the gold sting endpoint without adding an extra loop. Forebody/eye remain centred. Same single creature, strict directly overhead orthographic camera, clean transparent background, full figure, no floor, no shadow, no labels or diagnostic marks. Preserve simple broad volumes; no added surface noise. Correct geometry is more important than retaining an incorrect limb contour.
prompts.status: rejected whole concept, anatomy correction insufficient

prompts.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Turn this exact rigid blue articulated SCORPION maquette into ONE clean pale grey-pink fleshy horror game sprite, camera exactly vertically overhead. This maquette is the ONLY geometric authority. Preserve the exact silhouette layout, body-to-limb proportions, segment endpoints and every round joint centre. DO NOT REPOSE IT, DO NOT ADD ANY JOINTS. Add flesh AROUND these existing rigid segments. The 8 walking legs have one round external hinge each: two long straight links per leg. In particular the first walking leg pair points forward and outward from one knee, with no second knuckle. Retain the tips' forward direction shown; do NOT turn them backward like typical spider feet. Two separate front arms each have two arm links and one pincer with exactly two pointed fingers; keep their tips below y=100 and above y=180 on the input's 1024 square, and at the same x positions as the maquette. The tail has the exact six-link gold/blue curved chain of the maquette, and the small stinger ends pointing up-left at (645,776) in that 1024 canvas. Keep the complete eye-bearing torso at precisely the original location/size, add one pale round iris and a small black pupil at its existing eye marker. Compact rounded triangular front body and short segmented rear abdomen. Style: drawn 2D game monster, pale desaturated grey-rose/pink skin, broad soft painted volume, restrained dark outline, round visible joints, slender pointed ivory leg ends and pincer tips, like a fleshy mutant arthropod from a hospital horror game. The skin should be simple and calm with only a few folds at true joints, no microveins, no scaly armour, no cartoon human face, no glossy specular plastic. At most two or three small irregular dark red blood smears on tips. Do not preserve the blue colour, axis markings or flat schematic appearance. No external cast shadow, no illumination halo. Output exactly one centred complete creature in the SAME framing with generous outer margins. Transparent background. No labels, lines, numbers, arrows or reference diagram marks. Exact geometry matters more than decorative detail.
prompts.status: whole drawing not approved; named arm/tail paint surfaces reused only as native UV artwork

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct this overlaid scorpion to its painted skeletal guide. REDRAW each limb around the coloured guide line, with the exact major hinge at its white-ring marker; erase the old misplaced limb contours, do not move the guide to the old anatomy. Cyan lines: eight walking legs, each ONE external knee and two segments, with sharp tapered distal segments ending at the guide tips. Move each old knee to the corresponding white ring. Left upper knee currently too high/left must sit at the L1 white circle; middle horizontal knee currently too far left must sit at the L2 circle; lower diagonal leg currently misses the cyan guide on its distal link: rebuild it centred on the line. Mirror the same corrections right. Purple lines: two separate front arms and two-finger pincers, hinge at the top white circle and each finger ending at its own white tip circle; shorter fingers. Gold chain: replace the existing tail by six rigid fleshy links centred over exactly those lines, with each joint centred on the white ring, and stinger along the final line. Preserve the compact central body, pale grey-rose colour and single dorsal eye; place eye centre at (627,588) on this 1254 canvas. Rendering: sparse broad Stalker-like skin volumes and dark fine outline. Strict overhead view. Final result must be clean creature artwork with ALL coloured guide lines, letters, circles, nodes and diagram marks removed. Keep the canvas framing exactly. Transparent background instead of dark grey, no shadow or floor. No extra anatomical hinges, no added appendages, no regenerated loose details.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create just the CENTRAL TORSO sprite of a mutated scorpion in the exact fleshy pale grey-pink Stalker family of the reference. Do not include any limbs, no legs, no arms, no pincers and no tail. Single connected torso only, strict orthographic TOP DOWN, anterior at TOP. Rounded triangular forebody carrying ONE large pale radial iris with one dark pupil, no face or human head. Short compact abdomen of three broad soft interlocking segments continuing downward, with a single small rear tail attachment stub. Eight walking-leg attachment zones are unobtrusive shallow side sockets, four left and four right, no protruding stumps. Two subtle front palp sockets. Proportions: whole torso about twice as tall as wide; front triangular plate widest, rear abdomen gradually narrower. Broad calm painted pinkish flesh volumes, light grey-pink upper surfaces and muted mauve recesses, simple dark contour like reference. Very little small texture, no dense veins, no glossy plastic. Gentle consistent diffuse volume only, no cast shadow or ground. Transparent background. Body centered vertically, ample margin. No labels or diagram lines. One torso, not a sheet, not a complete scorpion.

Use case: background-extraction. Isolate ONLY the exact fleshy scorpion torso and its eye from this image on a truly TRANSPARENT background. Remove all the mauve/black gradient, glow and cast halo outside the hard outline. Preserve every part of the torso, all sockets, all three abdomen segments, the entire rear attachment and the single iris and pupil. Do not redraw, recolour or add limbs. Crisp antialiased body silhouette with genuine alpha zero immediately outside the dark outline; no soft external shadow, no floor, no gradient. Keep exact canvas dimensions and body location.
prompts.status: torso alpha source; RGB-only glow is hidden outside alpha

processing: Native sprite extraction, topology-based skinning, fixed 3D-length IK at export, local skin anti-fold barrier. No new paintings per frame. Unity consumes whole sprite frames, not this offline rig.
